name: BDF to mne/raw
summary: Converts an EEG recording in BioSemi BDF format to an MNE-Python raw FIF file with mne.io.read_raw_bdf.
description: Reads the bdf file with MNE-Python and saves it unchanged as raw.fif so that MNE-based MEG/EEG Apps can use it. The BIDS sidecar files (channels, electrodes, events) carried by the input are not used. Use it as the import step for BioSemi EEG data.

inputs.description: EEG recording in BioSemi BDF format (with optional BIDS sidecars, which are not read).

outputs.description: MNE Raw data in FIF format

citations.text: Gramfort A et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
